newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania refinancing loans 2.5 pct up in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Romania refinancing loans 2.5 pct up in Sept.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) refinancing loans rose by 2.5 percent in September with soft loans for farmers surging by 27.4 percent to 1.99 trillion lei, BNR data showed on Friday.
Total daily refinancing was 5.06 trillion lei on average in September, while Lombard loans, which charge an annual 90 percent interest, stayed low at only 5.4 billion lei.
While structural facilities fell to 755.4 billion lei in September from 969.2 billion in August, the auctioned credits expanded by 10.6 percent to 429.2 billion lei in September.

Support given to troubled banks Dacia Felix SA and Renasterea Creditului Romanesc Credit Bank SA of 1.87 billion lei was reflected in a separate account called "credits granted to debtors in dispute at law". The BNR does not charge interest on loans to those debtors.

In the past year the BNR gave special credits to keep afloat the two medium-sized banks after they revealed big debts and losses. Courts are expected to rule on their fate -- reorganisation or liquidation.

Average annual interest rates charged for each type of BNR's refinancing windows were 35 percent for structural loans, 54.1 percent for one-week funds. Support for farmers carried an annual 33 percent. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
